changeSet.author: Philipp.Bogatchev@Student.HTW-Berlin.de
changeSet.comment: Create contractor timelines table for the communication between a property manager and a single contractor organization about one quotation request
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS REMSFAL.contractor_timelines ( request_id UUID, timeline_id UUID, issue_id UUID, attachment_id LIST<UUID>, sender_id UUID, sender_name TEXT, sender_role TEXT, recipient TEXT, title TEXT, purpose TEXT, message TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP, modified_at TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY ((request_id), timeline_id) ) WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (timeline_id ASC);
